screens.note: Default player-facing featured showcase, before any interaction.
Default Create Game view; manual addressing remains behind Advanced.
Join Game invitation view before Advanced; inspect that raw IP and port fields are absent.
Advanced expanded; manual host and gameplay-port fields are now visible.
P1 Edit Deck opens with the default nine DEATH ENGINE selections.
All nine default balls removed by actual search/card clicks; expect 0/9 and disabled Use.
Attempting Use with zero selected must leave the builder open.
Nine GRAVITY TRAP source balls added through actual roster UI; expect 9/9.
Builder Use returns to setup with P1 custom deck.
Initial local match with portrait arena and 3x3 tray.
Actual scrollbar track clicked to bottom before selecting the third row.
Gatekeeper selected through the actual third-row orb card.
Default details: name, HP/size, quick text, ability and payoff; no implementation metadata.
F1 exposes technical migration/reference metadata in a separate developer overlay.
F1 off returns to the clean player details view.
Actual held shallow-angle mouse aim: first-wall contact and reflected continuation, before release.
Same held mouse gesture moved to normal upward aim: selected orb, vector, drag marker and power cue.
Attempted second drag during physics resolving; launch count remains one.
Next active player confirmed by selecting Blight Pool from P2 STATUS REACTOR deck.
Real right-click on the settled P1 Gatekeeper during P2 turn. Inspect canonical name, P1 live HP, CURRENT STATE and absence of developer IDs.
Actual INSPECT BOARD action during P2 turn; mode hint and Cancel Inspect are visible.
Actual Inspect Board then ordinary click selects the same P1 runtime instance during the opponent turn.
Fresh real P2 left-button aim before back-to-back empty-space right-button down and left-button release.
Back-to-back empty-space RMB-down and LMB-up: one accepted P2 launch, resolving state and cleared aim feedback.
390x844 showcase with visible bottom Start/All Decks actions.
Phone All Decks library opened with normal footer action; both player choices and canonical deck list.
Ordinary library wheel events expose the complete Reality Hackers row, nine previews and separate P1/P2 controls at 390px.
Actual left P1 control selects Reality Hackers for Player 1 while Player 2 retains Status Reactor.
Actual separate right P2 control selects Reality Hackers for Player 2; both chosen decks are visible above the scrolled list.
Normal library Start confirms Reality Hackers vs Reality Hackers with READY state and no accidental launch.
Fresh default Phone P1 Edit Deck opened through the library; measured helper, shifted search/selection, one-column cards and Use action.
Phone builder information button opens ordinary player details with readable orb/name/stats header.
Phone Bouncer details after an ordinary wheel-scroll attempt; its short honest fallback copy fits without overflow.
Portrait game: upper HUD, 540:900 arena, compact 3x3 tray in scrollable control panel.
Actual simulated touch held in aim state.
Touch canceled: aim feedback is cleared and no launch log emitted.
Real touch release launches once and shows resolving feedback.
Portrait lower Standard / Ball Details / Inspect Board / Match Setup controls reached through normal scrolling.
844x390 landscape reflows to portrait arena left, controls right.
Landscape lower controls reached through actual player scrollbar.
Actual third Match Setup action returns to setup in landscape.
Landscape Start begins another local match through the normal player flow.
Fresh 667x375 Android-user-agent small landscape context at showcase.
Small landscape All Decks library: player choices, scrolling canonical presets and Start footer must remain separated.
Twelve real wheel events reach the Reality Hackers name in the short landscape library; Start remains below its separate list viewport.
One further ordinary wheel event exposes both full Reality Hackers P1/P2 controls in the short list viewport.
Actual left P1 control selects Reality Hackers while the separate Player 2 choice retains Status Reactor.
Actual separate right P2 control also selects Reality Hackers; both player cards and separated Start footer are visible.
Normal library Start confirms Reality Hackers vs Reality Hackers in the compact canvas, without an accidental launch.

limits: Canvas-rendered text is visually reviewed in saved screenshots; no accessibility DOM or runtime state API is exposed by this player.
Touch is Chromium CDP simulation, not a physical Android/iOS device.
Multiplayer scope here is lobby presentation and Advanced containment; connection/authority validation is covered separately.

runtimeInspection.input: Real right mouse button on the existing settled ball, while P2 is confirmed active by ordinary selection log.

combinedRelease.input: Held real left aim, then back-to-back right-down, left-up and right-up at empty board space.
combinedRelease.limit: Browser event ordering is real; coincidence within one Unity update frame is not observable from this player.
